title: Modern Digital Alarm Clock with Gradient Design
description: This project is a sleek and modern digital alarm clock built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It features a gradient-style clock display, a user-friendly interface for setting and clearing alarms, and a soothing alarm sound. The clock updates in real-time, and users can set an alarm by selecting a specific date and time. The alarm will trigger at the specified time, and users can clear it at any point. The design is responsive and visually appealing, with a dark theme and vibrant gradients.
shortDescription: A stylish digital alarm clock with real-time updates, gradient design, and alarm functionality.
